reason: I already have more work than I can do, and my wife and a family member handle the phone and the quotes. Missing a call doesn't cost me anything right now, so why pay 149 a month to get even more enquiries I can't take on.
objection: I don't need more enquiries, I need fewer. And a brand-new company with no customers wants nearly 1,000 euros up front for something my family already does for free.
would_change_my_mind: If my wife or the family member stopped doing the phone, and it was cheap with no big setup fee.
